entities.summary: The National Human Rights Museum is a national museum of Taiwan with locations in New Taipei City and Green Island. The museum was established on March 15, 2018, and opened on May 18, 2018. The museum has collections of documents, research and educational materials relating to the period of martial law in Taiwan and works with museums in Taiwan and internationally.
